text:
Sam: heads-up: ran a load test and quota exhaustion scenario exposed a blind spot in streaming responses + redaction. when we switch to a degraded telemetry profile mid-stream, partial tokens still leak in logs.
Nina: yikes. can you paste the short repro? kernel logs + example payloads?
Sam: pasted snippet below:
```
STREAM_CHUNK: {
  "token_seq": ["The", " user", " said:", " \"confidently ", "my ssn is 123-45-"],
  "route": "/v1/chat/stream"
}
```
logs showed truncated token in plain text before redaction kicked in.
Carlos: that is because our redactor runs after the stream assembler. we need a streaming-safe redaction hook that operates per-token before write-to-log.
Lena: proposed approach: insert a redaction transformer into the stream pipeline with two modes: "scrub-on-write" (drop sensitive tokens, emit placeholder) and "hash-on-write" (emit deterministic hash for tokens that match PII regex). config per-route.
Nina: for embeddings/attachments: never emit the raw or partially hashed content in logs. always store a salt+hash and vector only. attachments should be blob-id only.
Sam: agree. also: metrics we need to add for canary: `stream.redactions.count`, `stream.partial_leak.detected`, `route.degrade_profile`, `route.degrade_reason`, `tenant.force_override`.
Carlos: about sampling interplay: if request was selected for full-sample (for evals), we must bypass redaction only if tenant has active breakglass AND an audit entry exists. otherwise eval sampling must respect redaction.
Lena: console changes: show live stream status (normal / degraded / scrubbed) on route detail. show last 24h count of `partial_leak.detected` with links to example hashes (no PII). allow pinning a tenant to opt-out of auto-degrade.
Nina: legal-bot: note: legal requires logging an admin action when a tenant is pinned to opt-out. also need retention policy for redaction hashes (90 days?).
legal-bot: confirmed: admin actions are auditable; retention for redaction hashes = 90 days default, extendable by compliance request. do NOT store raw tokens.
Sam: rollout plan: feature flag behind `stream-redactor-v1`. Stage to staging, then 5% tenants for 48h, monitor `partial_leak.detected` and `eval_prompt_set:pass_rate`. keep a 0.05% reserved sample of full unredacted requests stored in an encrypted vault for ML evals (requires breakglass to access).
Carlos: implement incremental schema: add `stream.redaction.v1` fields as optional. ops-bot: reminder to include migration docs for downstream consumers (logs pipeline, SIEM).
ops-bot: ticket created: infra-1234 streaming-redaction-schema-migration. tag @eng-sre, @eng-logging.
Nina: tests: unit for token-by-token redactor, e2e with simulated streaming spikes, fuzz test with attachments and embedding payloads. include perf benchmark to ensure <0.5ms/token overhead.
Lena: UX: tooltip on route: "When degraded, streams are scrubbed to reduce PII exposure and cost. Pin to prevent auto-degrade for critical tenants." link to docs. also add an explicit "why degraded" modal with timeline and triggers.
Sam: edge cases: 1) multi-part attachments arriving after text stream 3; ensure we correlate by request_id before deciding redaction. 2) third-party parsers (webhooks) that consume logs 3; we must version the event schema so parsers don't break.
Carlos: question: do we hash tokens or use redaction placeholders for deterministic debugging? hashing is reversible only with pepper, but we must treat pepper as secret. prefer placeholder + hashed fingerprint for correlation.
Nina: agree. fingerprint: sha256(salt + token) where salt is per-tenant rotateable. store salt in KMS-protected place.
Sam: action items: Sam -> quick PR with streaming hook interface, Nina -> embeddings/attachments guide update, Carlos -> telemetry + schema PR, Lena -> console badge + modal mocks. ops-bot created infra ticket. legal-bot: please prepare retention/verbatim for RFC.
Lena: I'll add the modal copy and a small changelog entry for customers.
Carlos: will wire `partial_leak.detected` alert: page at >10 in 1h for any tenant.
Sam: thanks. will kick off FF and schedule canary. keep observing `eval_prompt_set:pass_rate` and `stream.redactions.count`. revert if pass_rate drops >2% within 6h.
Nina: noted. I'll add tests and share PR link.
ops-bot: deploy queued: stream-redactor-v1 -> staging 2026-04-01T12:00Z. Canary target: 5% tenants.
Sam: perfect. closing for now, will post follow-ups.
